messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a narrow canary to unpin runtime 2.18.0 at 04:15 UTC (us-west2). This unlocks SDK 3.5.0 for quant-v5a and fixes an embedding alignment bug. Need ops + oncall watching for 45m.
chris: Why narrow canary? last time broad canary flagged p99 regressions.
maya: Exactly. We'll start at 5% traffic for 10m, then 15% for 15m, then 40% if green. Keeping lower initial exposure because embedding paths changed.
jordan: Can we route only inference routes that aren't heavy long-seq? e.g., embeddings + short chat.
maya: Yes - will limit to routes: embed-text, chat-short. Long-seq models stay pinned.
sarah-ops: I'll create transient alerts: runtime.unpin.embedding-regressions >= 2% and runtime.unpin.latency.p99 >= 25% . Also set diagnostic trace: TRACE=embed_align for 30m.
chris: Rollback triggers?
maya: Immediate rollback on: any user-visible embedding drift >2% (we'll run similarity delta job), p99 +25% over baseline for 10m, or any OOMs. If we hit any of those, redeploybot should re-pin and shift traffic back.
deploybot: [automated] Change request CR#7890 opened: unpin runtime 2.18.0 -> canary us-west2. Change window scheduled: 2026-03-23T04:15:00Z. Auto-rollforward disabled for 30m.
jordan: Throttle suggestion: start 5% with qps cap 40 req/s, run golden set of 1k embed queries for drift measurement.
maya: Config snippet:
```
# restrict route set
redwood route update --route embed-text --weight 0.05 --region us-west2
redwood route update --route chat-short --weight 0.05 --region us-west2
# qps cap
redwood qps set --region us-west2 --max 40
```
sarah-ops: I'll kick off the similarity delta job and tail embed logs. Will annotate any embedding metric > 1.8% as warning.
chris: Who is on rollback? maya + sarah-ops + release-oncall. Make sure docs updated with rollback playbook.
maya: Noted. Playbook link: https://go/relplay/unpin-rollback (DM me if you can't access).
deploybot: [automated] Change window started at 2026-03-23T04:15:07Z - canary us-west2 updated to runtime 2.18.0 (5% on embed-text/chat-short). Monitoring embedding drift & latency.
sarah-ops: 8m: similarity-delta 0.6% (good), p99 +6% (within), no OOM.
jordan: 10m: stepping to 15% now.
deploybot: [automated] Route weights updated to 15% at 2026-03-23T04:25:12Z.
chris: Seeing a small tail in p99 for chat-short when load hits bursts. Trace shows kernel scheduling pause in the async path. Opening ticket INF-682.
sarah-ops: 12m after step: similarity-delta 1.9% -> warning. Not yet rollback but close to threshold. Increasing sampling for embed checks to 5k queries/min.
maya: Keep close. If similarity-delta crosses 2% for 5 continuous minutes, we rollback.
jordan: Can we temporarily lower chat-short weight to 8% and keep embed-text at 15% to reduce burstiness?
maya: Doing that now.
deploybot: [automated] Route weights updated: chat-short 8% / embed-text 15% at 2026-03-23T04:34:50Z.
sarah-ops: After reweight: similarity-delta dropped to 1.3% and p99 stabilized. No OOMs.
chris: Good mitigation. Keep canary running for the full 45m window and then we'll decide on expansion.
maya: Agreed. If steady for 45m we'll schedule a phased unpin for all low-risk routes tomorrow morning with a preflight. Thanks everyone. :tada: :coffee:
deploybot: [automated] Canary change window completed at 2026-03-23T05:00:00Z - runtime 2.18.0 remains at restricted weights (embed-text 15%, chat-short 8%) in us-west2. No auto-rollback triggered. CR#7890 status: merged-canary.
